database.routers.simulation

Simulation management endpoints

Provides API for running and managing twin simulations

Attributes

router

Functions

Run a new simulation with specified parameters

list_simulations(session[, run_type, status, page, ...])

List simulation runs with optional filtering

Get details of a specific simulation run

get_simulation_data(run_id, session[, limit, offset])

Get raw simulation data in MES format

get_simulation_kpis(run_id, session)

Get KPI summary for a simulation run

Compare two simulation runs

Delete a simulation run and all associated data

Module Contents

database.routers.simulation.router[source]
async database.routers.simulation.run_simulation(request, manager)[source]

Run a new simulation with specified parameters

This endpoint: 1. Creates a new simulation run record 2. Executes the SimPy simulation 3. Stores results in MES format 4. Calculates KPIs 5. Returns run summary

Parameters:

  • request (database.schemas.SimulationRequest)

  • manager (database.dependencies.ManagerDep)

Return type:

database.schemas.SimulationResponse

async database.routers.simulation.list_simulations(session, run_type=None, status=None, page=Query(1, ge=1), page_size=Query(10, ge=1, le=100))[source]

List simulation runs with optional filtering

Filter by: - run_type: baseline, experiment, optimization, recommendation - status: pending, running, completed, failed

Parameters:

  • session (database.dependencies.SessionDep)

  • run_type (Optional[str])

  • status (Optional[str])

  • page (int)

  • page_size (int)

Return type:

database.schemas.SimulationListResponse

async database.routers.simulation.get_simulation(run_id, session)[source]

Get details of a specific simulation run

Parameters:

  • run_id (str)

  • session (database.dependencies.SessionDep)

Return type:

database.schemas.SimulationResponse

async database.routers.simulation.get_simulation_data(run_id, session, limit=Query(1000, ge=1, le=10000), offset=Query(0, ge=0))[source]

Get raw simulation data in MES format

Returns the simulation output data with pagination

Dict[str, Any]

async database.routers.simulation.get_simulation_kpis(run_id, session)[source]

Get KPI summary for a simulation run

Calculates: - Mean OEE, Availability, Performance, Quality - Total production and scrap - Scrap rate

Parameters:

  • run_id (str)

  • session (database.dependencies.SessionDep)

Return type:

database.schemas.KPISummary

async database.routers.simulation.compare_simulations(baseline_run_id, comparison_run_id, session)[source]

Compare two simulation runs

Calculates deltas for all KPIs and determines if the difference is statistically significant

Parameters:

  • baseline_run_id (str)

  • comparison_run_id (str)

  • session (database.dependencies.SessionDep)

Return type:

database.schemas.ComparisonResponse

async database.routers.simulation.delete_simulation(run_id, session)[source]

Delete a simulation run and all associated data

This will remove: - The run record - All simulation data - Any KPI snapshots

Parameters:

  • run_id (str)

  • session (database.dependencies.SessionDep)

Return type:

Dict[str, str]
